name: Alexandre Dumas
note: Alexandre Dumas père (1802–1870). The Three Musketeers (1844), first of the d'Artagnan romances, is held here complete, chapter by chapter, as the source text for the Amenti Studios production: library/alexandre-dumas/the-three-musketeers/ch00.md (Author's Preface) to ch68.md (Epilogue). Translation: the anonymous English translation of Project Gutenberg #1257, public domain.
